status: provisional geometric placement — not validated for fusion
method: 18 multi-start similarity ICP trials on vertical faces with same-facing normal filtering; source top and ceiling underside excluded from fitting. No generated geometry, surface welding or hole filling.
units: relative reconstruction units; not metres or independently checked survey accuracy

textureCheck.conclusion: Not sufficient to establish distinct, validated texture landmarks.

findings: Roof covers the gate opening in the expected general location.
Captured ceiling geometry intersects the placed roof at the central recess.
Rim gaps and capture artifacts remain visible.
Vertical placement and seams are not validated; a visually plausible footprint is insufficient evidence for a precise stitch.

decision: Keep the published and archival main reconstruction unchanged. Save an editable local roof-placement study for inspection.
cleanup: The disconnected fragment below the roof was omitted only from the study. Original ZIP, reference model, and master remain unchanged.
